passage:
Dear students,
Starting next Monday, the library will open during lunch break. Students may read, borrow books, or work quietly at the tables. Eating and drinking are not allowed inside the library.
To make the library more comfortable, we are also starting a "Book Buddy" shelf. If you have a book at home that you no longer read, you may bring it to the library and place it on the shelf. Other students can take it home and keep it. Please do not bring workbooks, test papers, or books with missing pages.
Every Friday, three students will help clean the reading area and put books back in the right places. If you want to help, write your name on the list at the front desk.
A quiet room becomes better when everyone takes care of it.
Ms. Wu
School Librarian

questions.stem: Which title is best for the complete passage that includes “Starting next Monday, the library will open during lunch break.”?

本文沒有陳述「The Class Library」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
